findings: F-T371-1: p.15 TYP. SLAB ON BEAMS DETAIL draws the top anchor bar's hook-down leg passing below the slab soffit into the edge beam: the Checker's F-T318-1 bound 'D less note-22 covers' holds for the bottom up-turn leg only.
